test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Eight friends, A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table. Four of them are sitting at four corners of the table and are facing the centre. The other four are sitting at the middle of each of the four sides and are facing opposite to the centre. E is facing the centre and is not an immediate neighbour of G. A is facing centre and is sitting at the third position from the right of G. D is sitting to the immediate right of B. B is facing the centre while C is not an immediate neighbour of A. There is only one person sitting between G and H.

Who among the following sits to the immediate right of F?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a square table. Four of them are sitting at four corners of the table and are facing the centre. The other four are sitting at the middle of each of the four sides and are facing opposite to the centre.

(1): A is facing centre and is sitting at the third position from the right of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/539f7431f70314fc2f3821408db4fb90aae07f0124f5fe5c11458aa37ce55945.png] 

(2): E is facing the centre and is not an immediate neighbour of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53f96b9a673e788f9b671a80c2882fcd87de95243854cc9b46462fe5890395c4.png] 

(3): There is only one person sitting between G and H. So, there are two possibilities.

Case(I): 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25963010e2e966d736e266a89da26010d78c6229dd34c17cbe555db3d8cd7053.png] 

Case(II):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7915b8abacba4f6833bc65f374c990b653248acb2502b4eb7c1ddf4b5d4f3c35.png] 

(4): D is sitting to the immediate right of B and B is facing the centre. So, case (II) will be eliminated.

Case(I):

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d21fd3428d8a0515e6de6b7aa281e0a4bbc829860ec7ccd709f0ff3fe7f9f4e.png] 

(5): C is not an immediate neighbour of A. So, the final arrangement will be

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6137f7dd660b748adad808fa81ebd85f3fa09200221ae99e7246c9f8d36d0b45.png] 

Therefore, E sits immediate right to the F.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (3)".**
